1KOMMA5°

 At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

 Learn about our Product & Tech team!

 Your mission

 As Senior Product Manager for Heating & Cooling, you own Heat as a product. What must be true in the household: space heating, hot water, and cooling people can trust, at a cost that makes sense, controlled with Heartbeat.

 You decide where Heating & Cooling goes next. Which problems we solve first. How hardware partners, the Energy Management System, and the customer experience add up to one result — in Germany and in the other markets we operate in. You own the problem, the requirements, and the outcomes.

 Your main focus will be to:

 
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for Heating & Cooling: where the area goes, and how it evolves across markets

 Define the customer outcome (comfort, cost, control, reliability) and the KPIs that prove it

 Turn hardware and field constraints into product requirements. Cut work that does not serve the outcome.

 Drive thermal optimization on our Energy Management System

 Align hardware, the Energy Management System, and the customer experience so households get one heat and cooling experience

 Write specs, run discovery, prioritize, and ship

 
 Your profile

 You have:

 
 5+ years of Product Management on hardware-software products, energy, HVAC, or similarly physical systems

 A track record of owning a customer outcome across more than one engineering team

 Comfort at the seam of OEM interfaces, optimization, and customer UX

 Excellent English and German

 Based in Germany or willing to relocate

 
 Bonus points for:

 
 Heat pumps, SG Ready, EEBus, Modbus, OEM cloud APIs

 Field or installer experience

 Thermal optimization or HEMS with heat pumps

 Heating and cooling products across more than one country

Senior Product Manager, Core People Technology

Location: London | Work model: Hybrid | Reports to: Senior Manager, People Product

About the team

People Technology builds and runs the systems behind every hire, transfer, leave, pay change and offboard for our workforce across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our mission is to make the operational backbone of People Operations invisible when it works — reliable, compliant, and scalable across dozens of markets — so our people teams can focus on people, not process. This role sits on the People Product team, working alongside Business Systems Analysts, engineers and delivery leadership to bring product thinking to one of our highest-volume, highest-consequence surfaces.

About the role

Core is the Workday and HR platform surface that nearly every People Operations process runs through — pay, leave, employment status, right to work, and multi-country compliance for a global workforce. Demand structurally exceeds capacity, and requests arrive from every direction without a shared shape. You'll be the first dedicated product manager for this space, responsible for turning that inbound chaos into a defensible, well-communicated plan — and, over time, for building the intake, frameworks and partnerships that let the space run on systems rather than on you.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll be shaping tickets and sizing work alongside analysts and engineers, not managing from above.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the prioritised order of work for Core — building a clear, ranked plan, explaining the reasoning behind it, and being explicit about what's being deferred and why

  • Turn vague or incomplete partner requests into documented problems, mapped current-state processes, and testable outcomes

  • Partner directly and regularly with People Operations, Compliance, Payroll, Total Rewards and Business Systems Analysts, including holding "not now" conversations without damaging the relationship

  • Work hands-on with analysts and engineers to shape, size, and write tickets, keeping an accurate and current picture of committed, shipped, and carried-over work

  • Build and evolve the operating model across the analyst and engineering pod — the mechanisms, documentation and intake processes that let the space run with less coordination overhead

  • Use AI tools to accelerate translation of messy, multi-format, multi-language inbound requests into structured requirements and plans, while applying clear judgment about what should never be automated (anything touching pay, leave, employment status or right to work)

  • Escalate proactively on statutory or audit exposure, cross-space dependencies, and any trade-off that would move a compliance date

  • Report progress and delivery against plan to partners and leadership, including clear communication when outcomes fall short

Requirements

  • Experience owning a product or systems area end-to-end, with real decision rights over scope and sequencing — not co-ownership of a feature

  • Hands-on background with Workday or a comparable HRIS as a product manager or technical program manager, with genuine understanding of configuration, business processes, and integrations

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise when demand structurally exceeds capacity, including a repeatable method (not just instinct) for deciding what to do and communicating what won't get done

  • Proven delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, comfortable starting when requirements are incomplete or undocumented

  • Experience translating a partner's requested solution into a well-defined problem, current-state understanding, and testable outcome

  • Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including compliance, payroll, or other regulated/audit-exposed functions

  • Practical fluency with AI tools for requirements drafting, documentation, and structuring unstructured information, paired with sound judgment about where not to apply them

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
 Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) 
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.

 Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
 Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
 Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
 Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
 Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
 Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
 Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
 Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
 Actively contributing to internal discussions.
 Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
 As Project Officer,  the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
 As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.
 

 We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
 As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
 As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years

jobs.title: Senior Projektleiter/in - Bau / Senior Project Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

Über die Rolle

Du möchtest die Zukunft des Wohnens aktiv mitgestalten – mit Fokus auf die Umsetzung? Du möchtest ein Team bilden, das mit Spaß an der Arbeit eine gute Performance erreicht? Als Senior Projektleiter/in - Bau / Senior Project Manager (w/m/d) bei uns, einem innovativen Generalübernehmer im nachhaltigen Wohnbau, übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Bauprojekte von der Bauantragseinreichung bis zur schlüsselfertigen Übergabe an einen zufriedenen Kunden. Du bist dafür zuständig, dass unsere Wohnbauprojekte (ab 4.500 m2 BGF aufwärts) termin- und qualitätsgerecht realisiert werden und verantwortest dabei die Kosten und Zahlungsströme.  

Insbesondere werden deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Koordination und Steuerung von Bauprojekten im Roh- und Schlüsselfertigbau unter Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen und technischen Zielsetzung
  • Termingerechte und qualitätssichere Umsetzung des vertraglichen Bau-Solls
  • Kontrolle des Bauablaufs und der Baustellenergebnisse
  • Koordinieren und überwachen der Einsätze von Fachingenieuren, Fachberater, Personal sowie Nachunternehmen
  • Führung und Organisation des Baustellenteams und Verantwortung über die Personaleinsatzplanung
  • Management von Kosten und Zahlungsströmen
  • Verhandlungsführung mit Auftraggebern und Nachunternehmen
  • Nachtragsgestaltung und -durchsetzung gegenüber den Auftraggebern 

Über dich

  • Einen Studienabschluss in der Fachrichtung Bauingenieurwesen oder Architektur bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation  
  • Erfahrung in der Projektleitung beim Bau von Großprojekten, idealerweise bei einem GU oder GÜ  
  • Reisebereitschaft zu unseren Baustellen deutschlandweit - du trägst die Projektverantwortung und entscheidest selbst, wann deine  Anwesenheit vor Ort notwendig ist
  • Einen sicheren im Umgang mit Office Produkten (Excel, Word...) und gängigen Projekt Management Softwares
  • Erfahrung in der Ressourceneinsatzplanung, Lean Construction ist ein Plus
  • Einen transparenten und kooperativen Kommunikationsstil sowie ein starkes Verhandlungsgeschick und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Teamgeist und eine selbstständige sowie verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise
  • Begeisterung für digitale Anwendungen und innovative Prozessgestaltung
  • Fließende Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse 

Was wir bieten

  • Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit 30 Urlaubstagen.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Wir bieten eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sprachkurse (Englisch/Deutsch) und Mitarbeiterrabatte bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Dich unsere externen Partner im Bereich mentale Gesundheit, um Deine psychische Gesundheit durch anonyme Einzel- oder Gruppensitzungen zu stärken.
  • Virtuelles Aktienprogramm: Profitiere von GROPYUS Erfolg durch unser Virtuelles Aktienprogramm.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du kannst wirklich etwas bewirken – auf allen Ebenen unserer Organisation. Finde Lösungen, treibe sie voran, teste und implementiere sie.

jobs.description:

 Impossible Cloud is a fast-growing B2B cloud company headquartered in Hamburg, Germany. We have built a cloud object storage solution comparable to AWS S3, purpose-built and optimised for AI and compute workloads. Our commercial hyper-growth speaks for itself, powered by our channel-first go-to-market strategy.

 We are now expanding beyond storage: we are building a high-performance compute platform, offering an end-to-end solution from GPU infrastructure to full GPU platform software stack. In doing so, we are redefining the cloud ecosystem by bridging the gap between decentralised infrastructure (DePIN), mainstream B2B cloud use cases, and AI applications.

 

 Find out more about us here .

 

 Please note that we can only consider candidates who have a valid, unrestricted work permit for the EU. 
 

 Your Impact

 You will own the product and go-to-market strategy for our GPU and AI services, working directly with the founders to define what we build, how we price and package it, and which customer segments and use cases we go after first. Success in 12 months means a validated commercial model with thousands of AI B2B customers and a product roadmap with huge customer pull behind it. 

 

 WHAT YOU WILL DO: 
 

 
 Direct the end-to-end GPU and AI services strategy and roadmap, taking full commercial accountability.

 
 Establish product-market fit by identifying high-advantage segments and use cases.

 
 Design pricing, packaging, and GTM strategies alongside sales and channel partners.

 
 Convert customer signals and research into clear, executable engineering backlogs.

 
 Serve as the technical product lead for enterprise accounts, discussing GPUs, networking, and AI workloads.

 
 Monitor competitors to ensure industry-leading positioning and features.

 WHAT YOU BRING: 
 

 
 Proven success leading cloud infrastructure or AI product strategy and revenue growth.

 
 Technical fluency in GPU architectures, AI/ML workloads, and cluster networking.

 
 Strong commercial instincts with experience in pricing and defining ICPs.

 
 Evidence-based approach, prioritizing customer data over personal opinion.

 
 Proficiency in using AI tools to optimize research and execution.

 
 Fluent English; additional European languages preferred.

 
 WHAT WE OFFER: 

 
 Competitive salary coupled with direct engagement in your success through an enticing ESOP.

 Clear and transparent career progression scheme inspired by the best performing organisations incl. fast track promotion opportunity for exceptional performance to support your growth ambitions.

 Prime growth-stage company with proven revenue and a sharp edge in cloud — founded by serial entrepreneurs with multiple successful exits.

 Experienced, passionate team working with cutting-edge cloud technology.

 A vibrant office in a trendy location with free brain food and a canteen — plus a subsidized premium gym membership and monthly team meet-ups that bring the whole crew together!

 
 

 OUR CULTURE: 

 We are committed to success. We embrace individuals from all backgrounds who share the goal of building a future European cloud champion, celebrated through a richly diverse team of 15+ nationalities and 10+ languages spoken.

 Apply : Submit your CV or LinkedIn profile via the application form.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) AI Projects
jobs.description:
The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) AI Projects, who will coordinate the planning, delivery, and resourcing of AI and robotics projects across engineering, research, and operations teams.

Your Responsibilities

  • Project Delivery: Define objectives, plan, and schedule projects, owning task allocation, resourcing, and execution through to deployment across distributed stakeholder locations.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Act as the interface between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, maintaining alignment on goals, milestones, and progress.
  • Team Coordination: Coordinate cross-functional project teams and facilitate Agile ceremonies such as Scrum and Kanban.
  • Risk Management: Identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, and resolve issues that threaten milestones or delivery commitments.
  • Hardware Procurement: Manage procurement of hardware and related equipment, coordinating with vendors and internal stakeholders on acquisition, delivery, and allocation within project budgets.
  • Process Improvement: Evaluate and refine project workflows and run post-project reviews to capture lessons learned.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Degree in robotics, computer science, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience managing technical projects.
  • Project Management: Experience managing complex technical projects with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), preferably in automation or robotics environments.
  • Communication: Verbal and written communication that translates technical concepts for varied audiences.
  • Technical Grounding: Working understanding of robotic system components, including sensors, actuators, and communication interfaces.
  • Language: Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Beneficial Skills

  • Technical Tools: Experience with ROS, Python, and Linux-based environments.
  • Chinese Language: Proficiency in Chinese.
  • Travel Readiness: Willingness to travel to stakeholder and customer locations (25–40%), primarily in East Asia.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

 

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. 

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sex

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!
 
 The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 
 
 While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.
 
 This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.
 

 Basic Qualifications:
 Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
 Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - AI LegalTech
jobs.description:
JUPUS baut die erste KI, die 80 % der Arbeit in Anwaltskanzleien selbstständig erledigt. In nur drei Jahren sind wir mit über 90 Mitarbeitenden in Köln, Berlin und einem internationalen Tech- & Product-Team gewachsen und zählen heute zu den prägenden Legal Tech Unternehmen Europas. Mehr als 2.000 Rechtsanwält*innen vertrauen JUPUS täglich ihre Mandate an.

 Unser Zielgruppenverständnis, unsere Recherche und unsere Produktentwicklung mit dem Markt sind bereits sehr reif. Was noch fehlt: dieses Verständnis zusammen mit unserem Leadership Team konsequent in unsere Go-to-Market-Organisation zu tragen.
 Genau deshalb suchen wir dich.
 Als Senior Product Marketing Manager (m/w/d) sorgst du dafür, dass unser Produkt im Markt klar positioniert, verstanden und erfolgreich verkauft wird. Du berichtest an unseren VP Marketing und arbeitest eng mit unserem Leadership Team, sowie Produkt, Sales und Customer Success zusammen.

 Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Zielgruppen- und Marktverständnis konsequent in Messaging, Website und Sales Enablement übersetzt wird

 Du positionierst unser Produkt klar gegenüber etablierten Legal Tech Anbietern

 Du rüstest unser Sales-Team mit den Werkzeugen aus, die es für überzeugende Gespräche und erfolgreiche Abschlüsse braucht

 Du machst den Erfolg unserer Kund*innen sichtbar, zum Beispiel durch Testimonials, Referenzen und Case Studies

 Deine Zeit verteilt sich ungefähr so: 30% Messaging & Positioning, 30% Collaterals & Website, 15% Audience & Market Research, 15% Sales Enablement, 10% Pricing & Packaging.
 Messaging Frameworks für unser Produkt entwickeln und über alle Kanäle konsistent verankern

 Positionierung und Narrative für Produkt- und Featurelaunches erarbeiten, mit klarer Differenzierung gegenüber etablierten Anbietern

 Website kontinuierlich ausbauen: Produkte, Features, Use Cases und Rechtsgebiete

 Testimonials, Referenzen und Case Studies gemeinsam mit Kund*innen entwickeln

 Zielgruppenanalyse und Markttrends im Legal-Tech-Umfeld laufend recherchieren und in Produkt- und Marketingplanung einspeisen, inklusive Buyer Personas und ICPs

 Competitive Intelligence und Battle Cards für das Sales-Team aufbauen sowie Sales-Enablement-Materialien und Trainings inhaltlich unterstützen

 Als Sparring-Partner in der Weiterentwicklung des Pricing und Packaging unseres Produkts fungieren

 Das solltest du mitbringen 
 Wohnort: Berlin/Köln und Umgebung 

 Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Marketing (Mid-Level bis Senior), idealerweise mit relevantem Anteil im B2B-SaaS- oder AI-Umfeld (SMB-Fokus von Vorteil)

 Nachweisliche Stärke in Narrativ-Entwicklung, Copywriting und Messaging, du übersetzt komplexe Produktthemen in klare, überzeugende Sprache

 Erfahrung im Aufbau von Sales-Enablement-Programmen und enger Zusammenarbeit mit Sales-Teams

 Erfahrung in der inhaltlichen Weiterentwicklung von Unternehmenswebsites

 Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit hohem eigenem Qualitätsanspruch

 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch

 Erfahrung in der Rechtsbranche ist ein großer Pluspunkt, Erfahrung bei einem Legal Tech Anbieter ist aber nicht erforderlich

 Unser Setup 
 Hybrid arbeiten mit regelmäßigem Austausch vor Ort an unseren Standorten in Köln und Berlin

 Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Sales und Produkt

 Schnelles, pragmatisches Umfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

 Die Chance, Product Marketing bei JUPUS von Grund auf mit aufzubauen

 Direkten Einfluss auf Positionierung, Pipeline und Wachstum unseres Produkts

jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d) - Customer Domain
jobs.description:
Über uns Seit 2008 arbeiten wir mit unseren vier Marken doctari, lichtfeld, Planerio und arztpool an unserer Vision, medizinisches Personal dorthin zu bringen, wo es am dringendsten benötigt wird. 
 doctari pro ist unsere B2B-Buchungsplattform für Personalverantwortliche in Krankenhäusern und Gesundheitseinrichtungen und die zentrale Schnittstelle zur Demand-Seite unseres Marktplatzes. Über doctari pro können Ärztinnen und Ärzte unkompliziert gefunden, angefragt und gebucht werden: in Arbeitnehmerüberlassung oder befristeter Anstellung. Als Gegenstück zur doctari App auf der Kandidatenseite ist doctari pro ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres zweiseitigen Marktplatzes. 

 Deine neue Rolle Als Product Owner (m/w/d) im Customer Domain Team übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen der wichtigsten Wachstumshebel unseres Unternehmens. Gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team gestaltest du die Produktstrategie ebenso aktiv mit wie die Umsetzung neuer Features und bringst moderne Technologien wie KI gezielt in die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro ein. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering, UX Design und internen Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst fundierte Produktentscheidungen auf Basis von Nutzerdaten, technischen Anforderungen und Marktanforderungen. 
 
 Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team innovative Features für Kliniken und Gesundheitseinrichtungen, von der Anfrage bis zur Buchung.

 Du priorisierst das Product Backlog anhand von Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktanforderungen und relevanten Produkt-KPIs.

 Du steuerst den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess von der Product Discovery über Delivery bis zum erfolgreichen Release.

 Du arbeitest mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen und übersetzt Marktanforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen.

 Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Buchungsdaten, leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab und optimierst kontinuierlich die Customer Journey auf doctari pro.

 Du treibst den gezielten Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Produkt voran.

 

 Deine Erfahrung & Persönlichkeit Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS-, Plattform- oder Marketplace-Umfeld.

 Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte für Geschäftskunden: von der Product Discovery über nutzerzentriertes Design bis zur datengetriebenen Optimierung.

 Technisches Verständnis, das tief genug geht, um Architekturentscheidungen zu verstehen, Trade-offs zu bewerten und mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren.

 Analytisches Denken, Pragmatismus sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
 Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Produkte und moderne Technologien, die du aktiv nutzt, um Produktmehrwert zu schaffen.

 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Account Management oder Customer Success ist ein klares Plus.

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

jobs.description:
Your mission As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem , you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.
 ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.
 Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.
 You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.
 Your day-to-day  
 Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
 Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
 Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
 Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
 Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner , balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
 Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
 Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
 Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.

 Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.

jobs.title: Product Manager - EXOtube
jobs.description:
Introduction Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. 
 
Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across  48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Key to our success is a combination of an expert Mission Management team, our growing portfolio of in-house designed and market leading separation systems, and our rideshare structures including EXOtube . Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager  is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects , becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. You will also help the business team in marketing and selling EXOtube projects, shaping how it is seen on the market and helping us identify market demand. 

 Your role is based at our headquarters in Berlin, Germany . The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward. 

 Your mission Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects . 

 Lead communication with customers and ensure a fluent progression of the project. 

 Help develop concepts for Ground Support Equipment and test hardware and coordinate with suppliers. 

 Plan and participate in test and launch campaigns internationally. 

 Create and maintain documentation incl. User Manuals, Sales materials, technical reports and internal and external procedures. 

 Work hand-in-hand with the Sales team to answer prospect’s questions regarding Exolaunch’s capabilities and services, including EXOtube’s compatibility with different launch vehicles and other Exolaunch products. 

 Solidify and expand upon Exolaunch’s commitment to customer care and service excellence . 

 Write proposals alongside the business team to bid for the hardware development and launch of satellite constellations. 

 Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level 

 Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities. 

 

 Your profile Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in structural, mechanical or space engineering or a similar field. 

 5+ years of engineering work experience. 

 Experience in customer-facing work and sales work. 

 Excellent written and spoken English. 

 Excellent technical communication skills. 

 Strong experience in working with CAD software such as SolidWorks. 

 Strong sense of style and form to be able to integrate Exolaunch style into documentation and hardware design. 

 Positive attitude and ability to work in a highly integrated team setting. 

 Ability to work in a fast-paced and demanding environment. 

 Flexibility for travel, occasionally at short notice 

 

 Why us? Competitive compensation package tailored to your experience and responsibilities 

 Subsidies for lunch, mobility, and special occasions, depending on eligibility 

 Flexible working hours and a friendly, collaborative atmosphere 

 State-of-the-art Office in the heart of Berlin at Potsdamer Platz 

 Access to an in-house gym at the HQ 

 All necessary IT equipment and office tools to perform your role effectively 

 Complimentary drinks, snacks, and fresh fruit, plus a well-equipped office environment 

 Regular team gatherings, celebrations, and internal events 

 

 Travel Expectations The position requires flexibility for regular travel, including short-notice trips. You should be comfortable with traveling approximately at 10-15% of your work time. 

 Location Requirement This role is based in Berlin. Candidates must either currently reside in Berlin or be open to relocating.

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Product Led Growth- Paris (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product team at Doctolib.

Your mission: scale Doctolib's acquisition engine into a measurable, lower-cost growth driver across France, Germany and Italy. You will own the end-to-end product-led and marketing-led growth funnel, from freemium offer design to subscription and in-product upsell, contributing directly to growing ARR while bringing the cost to acquire new practitioners down.

Building at Doctolib means shipping products that change how care teams and patients experience healthcare every day.

 


What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own Doctolib freemium offer: define what is free, metered, or demo-only, and design the conversion paths that move practitioners to a paid plan
  • Own and improve the subscription funnel for new business and upsell, across web and in-product surfaces, including checkout and sign-up unification
  • Design and improve every in-product flow that moves an existing customer to a higher-value plan
  • Define acquisition-side packaging: offer catalogue, eligibility rules, and contract signature flows across France, Germany and Italy
  • Lead marketing-led growth initiatives, including lead generation, B2B website conversion, and lifecycle marketing, connecting them to the core product funnel
  • Set the direction for cross-team delivery (along with the PMMs and other counterparts), deciding offer by offer and country by country when conversion is the right path, and when to route a user to sales as a warm, product-qualified lead

 


Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

 

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You have owned a PLG conversion, ARR or CAC metric as your primary objective in B2B SaaS at scale, and can quantify what it moved, from what baseline, over what period
  • You have scaled product-led growth alongside a sales motion, and can explain how you chose between autonomous conversion and handing sales a warm lead, offer by offer
  • You read data yourself, define funnel measurement from scratch, and make decisions with experiments rather than opinion
  • You have solid product judgement on pricing, packaging, eligibility and freemium boundaries, and can work within a regulated environment with consent and country-specific constraints in mind
  • You set direction for teams you do not manage and move a metric across a cross-functional chain
  • You are fluent in English

 

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have owned both product-led and marketing-led growth, connecting lifecycle, attribution or lead scoring to the product funnel
  • Have worked across multiple countries with different pricing or packaging constraints
  • Have experience in a regulated or healthcare context

 


What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib
  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class
  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription
  • ParentCare Program: full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib
  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
  • Relocation support in case of international mobility
  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

 


Our interview process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime)
  • Hiring Manager Interview (Louis Durteste) 
  • Case Study with Product Panel
  • Behavioral Interview
  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page

jobs.title: Langfuse - Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Why this role exists 
 Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.
 Since being acquired by ClickHouse, with access to ClickHouse's broader GTM resources, Langfuse now has a growing enterprise motion and a large self-hosted user base.
 This role exists to give Langfuse a clear, accurate narrative that is easier to understand and adopt.
  
 How The Role Works 
 This role is for a product marketer who likes technical depth. A technical background is a strong plus, you should be technical enough to use the product, understand the market, earn credibility with engineers, and spot vague or misleading marketing.
 You'll become a true power user of Langfuse, and gain a front-row seat into how the best AI teams build production applications.
 You should expect close working relationships with both Langfuse teams and ClickHouse’s product marketing, sales and regional GTM teams.
  
 What we're looking for 
 Substantial experience in product marketing, product, or a technical role, including time spent on industry or vertical marketing.

 Past track record of crafting compelling messaging, positioning, and value propositions that resonate with developers, technical buyers, AI teams, enterprise stakeholders, and other highly technical audiences.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely.

 You have a technical background and an analytical mindset with the capacity to leverage data and metrics to measure performance in open-source PLG funnels and inform decision-making.

 Cross-functional collaborator comfortable working with stakeholders across functions and levels.

 A strong plus if you have a background in dev tools, open source, observability, or data/cloud infra. and/or if you have an existing public content or writing presence.

  
 What you'll do 
 Build messaging, positioning, and value props that work for developers, technical buyers, and enterprise stakeholders alike

 Own the category narrative (LLM observability, evals, prompt management, agent observability, self-hosting)

 Create sales enablement and marketing collateral and assets, including website content, blogs, webinars and presentations, launch narratives, and more

 Conduct competitive analysis to understand market trends, identify opportunities, and inform product and marketing strategies

 Evaluate and iterate on strategies with metrics and feedback from stakeholders to track efficacy, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven recommendations

 Lead product and feature launches, and spend time with users, customers, prospects, sales, support, and community members.

  
 Perks 
 Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

 Culture - We All Shape It
 As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.
 Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.
 Equal Opportunity & Privacy
 ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. 

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! 
 We're looking for people with software engineering backgrounds who are ready to move into technical project management, owning the business systems work behind our transition from a legacy stack to a new one. These are growth paths, not fully-formed PM seats.
 Our legacy stack involves over 100 systems across the globe including proprietary invoicing/billing/scheduling systems, two Salesforce instances and NetSuite, among others. Our new stack is HubSpot, Metronome, Stripe, NetSuite, and Workato. Getting from one to the other — while the business keeps running on both — is the core challenge of both tracks.
 We're hiring two people into this role. The skills profile is similar for both, but each hire will own one of two distinct tracks: O2C Integrations or CRM Projects . These tracks will eventually mature into a larger scope of internal tooling and enterprise customization.  Co-build the Legacy system replacement s— Partner with the Enterprise product team as technical owner of how the new platform's O2C integration layer is architected, including data models and API contracts.

 Control integration vendors — Own technical evaluation, SLAs, and build-vs-buy decisions for integration tooling and vendors across the ecosystem.

 Bridge legacy and new-stack engineering teams — Be the technical point of contact ensuring O2C data contracts and dependencies are understood on both sides.

 
 Track 2: CRM & Martech Projects 
 Focused on retiring and migrating CRM systems 
 Lead the Salesforce 2A sunset project — Own the plan, timeline, and execution for retiring this legacy Salesforce instance, coordinating data migration and cutover with dependent teams.

 Lead the Salesforce STAR sunset project — Same ownership model, applied to the STAR instance.

 Control the HubSpot vendor relationship — Own vendor management for HubSpot, including contract terms, SLA performance, and roadmap alignment with vendor capabilities.

 Own marketing automations — Own the roadmap and execution for marketing automation workflows (built largely on HubSpot). Campaign strategy sits with Marketing; you own the tooling and execution layer those campaigns run on.

 Manage sunset risk — Identify what breaks if a legacy system goes away too early, and build technically sound mitigation and rollback plans.

 Software engineering background — you've built, maintained, or integrated production systems, ideally including APIs, middleware, or data pipelines.

 Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders alike.

 Detail oriented and structured approach — planning and running complex, multi-stakeholder technical projects to completion, including sequencing, risk management, and timeline ownership.

 Comfortable reading and reasoning about system architecture and data models across multiple connected systems without translation from engineering.

 Comfortable with ambiguity, especially around evolving scope boundaries between adjacent teams during a platform migration.

 
 Nice to Have 
 Familiarity with billing/invoicing/CRM systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, HubSpot, Stripe, Metronome, Workato, or similar).

 Experience with vendor management, including contract and SLA negotiation.

 Background in a company undergoing a legacy-to-modern platform migration.

 Experience defining integration strategy or standards at an organizational level, not just shipping individual integrations; exposure to integration architecture patterns (point-to-point, iPaaS/middleware, event-driven).

 Formal project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) — helpful but not required with structured ways of working

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. 

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Platform team in an internal-facing role focused on delivery excellence. You'll be the connective tissue across product teams — enabling fast, informed decision-making, keeping engineering delivery on track day-to-day, making sure our platform holds up to country-specific regulatory requirements as we scale globally and defining requirements for the platform back office.
 Alongside the day-to-day delivery work, you'll run a set of platform-wide programs: centralizing consent management and interfacing with the GTM team.  Delivery & Coordination

 Lead daily ceremonies — Run stand-ups and other recurring delivery ceremonies with engineering, keeping teams aligned on priorities, blockers, and progress.

 Troubleshoot with engineering — Partner directly with engineering leads to unblock delivery issues in real time, digging into technical details as needed.

 Lead triage for cross-cutting bugs and defects — Own the process for identifying, prioritizing, and assigning ownership of issues that span multiple product areas or teams, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

 Drive process improvement — Identify recurring delivery bottlenecks or compliance gaps and put in place scalable processes to prevent them.

 Platform Delivery (Program) 
 Country-specific requirements — Own the platform-wide program ensuring the platform meets country-specific regulatory and functional requirements (e.g., GDPR and other regional regulations) consistently as we scale globally.

 Centralize consent management — Lead the program to consolidate consent management (data processing, marketing, cookie consent, etc.) into a single, consistent framework across the platform, replacing fragmented per-product implementations.

 Build the platform back office for technical support .

 
 What We're Looking For
 6+ years of product management experience, including experience in platform or delivery-focused roles.

 Proven ability to work across multiple teams and stakeholders to drive decisions quickly, especially in ambiguous or contested situations.

 Strong operational rigor — comfortable running ceremonies, triage processes, and cross-team workflows, alongside running longer-running platform programs and owning a live product.

 Experience working closely with engineering on troubleshooting and delivery issues; technical fluency is important.

 Experience owning a partner-facing or multi-market product, with sensitivity to regional variation across a large footprint (70 countries, in this case).

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders (including GPMs) without direct authority.

 A bias toward action and strong prioritization instincts in a fast-moving, cross-cutting role.

 
 Nice to Have
 Experience in a platform or infrastructure product role at a multi-market or global company.

 Background working with legal/compliance teams on regulatory rollouts, especially consent management programs.

 Experience setting up or scaling incident management, bug triage, or internal support tooling.

 Experience with franchise, partner, or multi-tenant portal products specifically.

 
 Why You Should Join 
 Most internal-facing delivery roles are pure coordination — you keep other people's things moving and own nothing yourself. jobs.title: Head of Product and Strategy | ROB'E
jobs.description:
Head of Product & Strategy

Location: Hamburg, Germany (with regular travel in Europe and to the US)  
Reports to: Founders (Dr. Jury Schewel & Dr. Dimitry Schewel) 
Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity participation  

About the Venture – ROB’E

ROB’E is an early-stage MedTech venture developing an AI-powered robotic platform for echocardiography. The technology aims to transform cardiac imaging and enable more precise, image-guided structural heart interventions.

The company was founded by Dr. Jury Schewel and Dr. Dimitry Schewel, both cardiologists and clinical leaders at Marienkrankenhaus Hamburg. ROB’E is part of the venture portfolio of NLC Health Ventures.

The company has already achieved key milestones, including:

  • First-in-human use of its robotic TEE system
  • Strategic partnership with a leading imaging player
  • Strong clinical collaborations and scientific validation

ROB’E is now entering a critical phase of product development, clinical validation, and fundraising.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and highly driven leader to join ROB’E as Head of Product & Strategy. This role is ideal for someone who wants to take a breakthrough medical technology from early clinical proof-of-concept to a globally scalable company. You will work closely with the founders and take increasing responsibility for strategy, product development, fundraising, and business building.

Your Role

Drive Strategy & Company Building

  • Shape the overall company strategy, business model, and go-to-market approach
  • Conduct market, customer, and competitive analyses
  • Develop commercialization strategies for Europe and the US

Lead Product Development

  • Translate clinical needs into clear product requirements
  • Drive development toward design freeze and product-market fit
  • Ensure execution against milestones, timelines, and budget

Advance Clinical & Regulatory Pathways

  • Coordinate clinical validation and usability studies
  • Support regulatory strategy toward CE marking and FDA approval
  • Build and maintain relationships with clinical partners and KOLs

Fundraising & Partnerships

  • Prepare investor materials and support fundraising processes
  • Engage with investors, strategic partners, and grant providers

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
jobs.description:
You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Day to day, you will:

  • Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
  • Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
  • Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
  • Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on. 
  • Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
  • Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
  • Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

What you’ll bring

  • A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
  • Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
  • The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
  • Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
  • A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
  • An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
  • A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

What you’ll need

  • Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
  • The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
  • Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
  • A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
  • Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
  • As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

What success looks like

Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists. You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedu

jobs.title: AI Transformation Owner, Product & Design
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.

Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.

You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.

What you'll do

Strategy & Prioritization

  • Own your function's AI strategy, aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.
  • Map how work flows across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?
  • Manage intake of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.
  • Prioritize strategically against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.

Adoption & Change Management

  • Reimagine, not just automate. Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.
  • Drive adoption and change management together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.
  • Coordinate with Enterprise AI to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.
  • Build and bridge the Champion network in your function. Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly.
