jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Machine Learning
jobs.description:
The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.

The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change. 

One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines. 

That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.

Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.

Join us to help us build a more resilient world together. 

Role & Team

You’ll lead a core part of our Vegetation Intelligence, the product area that turns remote sensing imagery and data into the vegetation insights that utilities act on every day, through world-class machine learning models. It’s one of Overstory’s most foundational products, live with customers now, and it sits at the center of how we prevent outages and stop wildfires. Every missed tree is an outage or a fire that could have been prevented.

The job is twofold. One is real ML-adjacent work: pushing our detection models further and turning their raw outputs into risk data precise enough for customers to trust and act on. You’ll need to be comfortable with complex machine learning models and geospatial data, close to the data science and engineering teams, and fluent enough in model trade-offs to make good calls with data scientists and ML engineers.

The other side is where you get to build new capabilities: taking that same data and pushing it into new products and capabilities customers don't have yet. You'll run user research, ground new product bets in the decisions customers make in the field, and turn a strong model into products that prevent real fires and real outages.

You’ll report to the Director of Product and own the strategy and roadmap for this product area end to end.

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap for Vegetation Intelligence, spanning from the ML models that produce our risk data to the products that turn it into customer action.
  • Push our detection models further, and help fold their outputs into Overstory’s broader outage and ignition risk models.
  • Contribute towards increasing the number of actionable insights: run user research, ground priorities in the operational decisions customers actually make, and make sure what we ship drives real action in the field.
  • Shift the roadmap from scaling- and technical-led to customer-driven, without losing the technical rigor that got us here.
  • Work closely with data scientists and ML engineers to turn model capability into shipped product value, and define what “good” looks like for a model in production.
  • Explore how feedback from customers and end users, like arborists, can improve model performance over time.
  • Communicate clearly and often with the broader product and engineering team, so trade-offs, model limits, and priorities stay visible.
  • Contribute to Overstory’s broader product strategy so Vegetation Insights supports where the rest of the product is headed

Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record that proves both craft and shipping speed.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping products powered by machine learning models. You understand how models get built, trained, evaluated, and improved, and you can talk model performance and trade-offs directly with data scientists and ML engineers.
  • Experience turning a scaling- or technical-led roadmap into a customer-driven one, including runni

jobs.title: Cloud Platform - Senior Digital Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
La Cloud Platform Engineering recherche un(e) Senior Digital Product Manager basé(e) à Lille.

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons qu’il est essentiel de rendre les joies et les bienfaits du sport accessibles à tous.

Pour y parvenir, nos équipes ont besoin d’un système d’information performant, évolutif et sécurisé. La Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) contribue à cet enjeu en développant des produits et services internes qui simplifient la vie des équipes tech, accélèrent la livraison, renforcent la sécurité et améliorent la maîtrise des opérations et des coûts.

Au sein de cet écosystème, notre offre Cloud Platform s’appuie sur plusieurs produits complémentaires :

  • 3S (Self Service Stack), notre plateforme interne de self-service cloud principalement orientée GCP ;
  • Cloud Kraft, qui complète notre offre de plateforme sur les services non industrialisé dans la 3S ;
  • notre service managé sur AWS, destiné à accompagner les équipes ayant des besoins spécifiques sur cet environnement.

Ensemble, ces produits permettent aux équipes de provisionner, déployer, faire évoluer et opérer leurs assets cloud via une approche standardisée, industrialisée et documentée, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur la sécurité, la résilience, l’observabilité et la maîtrise des coûts.

Ta mission

En tant que Senior Digital Product Manager, tu pilotes l’évolution de notre portefeuille de produits Cloud Platform, avec un rôle central sur 3S, Cloud Kraft et notre offre de service managé AWS.

Ton rôle est de maximiser la valeur apportée aux équipes utilisatrices en améliorant :

  • la clarté de l’offre et son positionnement ;
  • la qualité de l’expérience développeur ;
  • l’adoption des composants et services de la plateforme ;
  • la cohérence produit entre provisioning, standards, documentation, accompagnement et intégration dans l’écosystème engineering de Decathlon.

Tu interviens au croisement du produit, de la plateforme et des usages, avec une forte sensibilité à la scalabilité, à la sécurité, à la standardisation, à l’observabilité et à la maîtrise des coûts.

Tes responsabilités

Vision et stratégie produit

  • Définir et porter la vision produit de notre offre Cloud Platform et de ses différentes briques.
  • Clarifier le positionnement, les promesses, les cas d’usage et les priorités de 3S, Cloud Kraft et du service managé AWS.
  • Faire évoluer l’offre en cohérence avec les besoins des équipes, les contraintes d’engineering et les tendances du marché cloud.

Discovery & connaissance utilisateur

  • Mener une discovery continue auprès des équipes engineering, plateforme, sécurité et produit.
  • Comprendre les irritants, les besoins réels et les arbitrages entre autonomie, sécurité, standardisation, time-to-market et coût.
  • Transformer les retours terrain en opportunités produit concrètes et priorisées.

Roadmap & delivery

  • Piloter une roadmap multi-produits, en lien étroit avec les équipes d’ingénierie.
  • Prioriser les évolutions en fonction de la valeur utilisateur, de l’impact business et des enjeux techniques.
  • Suivre l’exécution jusqu’à la mise à disposition effective des fonctionnalités et services.

Adoption, documentation et change

  • Améliorer l’intégration des produits dans les parcours engineering et dans l’IDP.
  • Porter une documentation claire, maintenable et orientée usage.
  • Accompagner l’adoption via la pédagogie, les formations, les rituels et l’évangélisation produit.

Mesure de la performance produit

  • Définir les KPIs de performance, d’adoption, de satisfaction et d’efficience.
  • Utiliser la donnée pour éclairer les décisions produit et soutenir les arbitrages d’investissement.
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes concernées sur les enjeux FinOps et d’optimisation d’usage sur GCP comme sur AWS.

Ton profil

jobs.title: Product Manager (Protocol)

About Morpho
 Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.
  
 Why Morpho Exists
 Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here .

 Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

 Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work. 
 
 This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.
  
 Responsibilities
 Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

 Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

 Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

 Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

 Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

 Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

 Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

  
 What Success Looks Like
 First 30 days
 You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.
  
 First 3 months
 You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

 You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution.

jobs.title: ERP Rollout Project Manager – Manufacturing & Supply Chain
jobs.description:
We want you to grow with us 
 We are expanding our international IT organisation and looking for an ERP Rollout Project Manager – Manufacturing & Supply Chain to join our cross-functional IT Project and Portfolio Management Team. In this role, you will manage IT delivery within ERP implementation and rollout projects across multiple functions, sites and countries. As part of the wider rollout team, you will ensure that technical, infrastructure and operational activities are planned and aligned with the overall ERP rollout. You will combine strong IT project management capabilities with a solid understanding of ERP environments and the technology dependencies required to successfully deploy them within manufacturing operations. Your work will help modernise our systems, harmonise processes and deploy new capabilities across our European operations. 
 Please note: This role may require travel to Intersnack locations and project offices up to 30–40% of the time.
 
 What we can offer 
 You will have the opportunity to manage IT delivery across the lifecycle of international ERP rollout projects, from planning and mobilisation through testing, deployment, cutover, go-live and stabilisation. 
 Working closely with business teams, IT specialists, local sites and external partners, you will operate at the intersection of ERP, business processes and site technology. This includes ensuring that infrastructure, devices, access and other technical dependencies are ready to support manufacturing, supply chain and logistics operations. 
 How you will spend your time as our next ERP Rollout Project Manager

You will own the IT project plan, coordinate the relevant workstreams and ensure that milestones, dependencies, risks and deliverables remain aligned with the wider rollout.

 Own and maintain the IT project plan, ensuring alignment with the wider ERP rollout and its business and functional workstreams 

 Coordinate internal IT teams, business stakeholders, local sites, external implementation partners and service providers 

 Translate rollout requirements into clear project activities, milestones, dependencies and deliverables 

 Ensure infrastructure and site technology requirements are incorporated into the rollout plan, including connectivity, user access, handheld devices, scanners and printers 

 Coordinate testing, deployment, site readiness, cutover and go-live activities within the assigned IT scope 

 Manage project scope, timelines, resources, budgets, risks, issues and dependencies, including appropriate reporting and escalation 

 Support business readiness, training coordination and post-go-live stabilisation together with the wider rollout team 

 Apply established project management standards and contribute to continuous improvement of project delivery across the portfolio 

 
 What we expect from you 
 Several years of experience managing complex IT projects, including experience within an end-to-end ERP implementation or rollout 

 Ideally, experience with ERP rollouts across multiple sites, countries or business units within an international organisation 

 A solid high-level understanding of ERP systems, including how modules, integrations and business processes interact 

 Good understanding of manufacturing, supply chain and logistics processes, ideally gained within food, FMCG, process manufacturing or a comparable industry 

 Understanding of the wider technology dependencies involved in ERP rollouts, including infrastructure, connectivity, access, devices and integrations 

 Experience coordinating testing, deployment, cutover, go-live and post-implementation activities 

 Strong project planning, stakeholder management, risk management and problem-solving capabilities across cross-functional and geographically distributed teams 

 A structured, hands-on and solution-focused approach with the ability to operate effectively within a complex matrix organisation

jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members across UK and India
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • Over 2,800 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, and Threat Detection & Response.

Product Security (this role!) consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Identity (this role!) is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

Threat Detection & Response focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We're proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As the Head of Product and Identity Security, you'll own two of those three areas, reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and operating as a peer to the Head of Threat Detection & Response. The remit spans application security, penetration testing, cloud security, artificial intelligence (AI) security, secure architecture, identity, and vulnerability operations. You'll lead a global team across the UK, Eastern Europe, and India, and you'll stay close to the technology: this is a player-manager role, where credibility is earned by doing the work as well as directing it. This is a real opportunity to make an impact and have senior influence on the cyber resilience strategy at Tide.

  • Leading, coaching, and growing a global team across the UK, Eastern Europe, and India; setting clear objectives; running regular 1:1s; and supporting career growth and progression.
  • Owning application security end-to-end, from secure design reviews and threat modelling through to secure coding standards, tooling, and remediation of findings.
  • Running the penetration testing programme across web, mobile and infrastructure, including internal testing and the management of external partners, and staying hands-on where it counts.

We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.

 Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
 Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.

 Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
